messages.content: 誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
我不確定現在哪位網球選手正處於世界排名第一，因為這個名次會隨著比賽結果而頻繁變動。若您想知道最新資訊，可以參考以下官方資源：

| 資料來源 | 網站 |
|----------|------|
| ATP 世界巡迴賽（男子） | https://www.atptour.com/zh-rankings/singles |
| WTA 女子單打排行榜 | https://www.wtatennis.com/rankings |

在上述網站上，通常能即時看到「ATP 頂級」或「WTA 頂級」欄目中當前排名第一的選手姓名、國籍及其最近一場比賽紀錄。

如果您需要更進一步的歷史資料，例如某一年特定季節的排名，我可以協助查詢；請告訴我要調取的年份與聯盟名稱。例如：  
```json
{
    "team_name": "",
    "league": "",
    "season_year": 2025
}
```
但對於個人選手而言，目前沒有直接可用的工具來取得此類數據。
message.reasoning:
The user asks "Who is currently ranked first tennis player?" They want ranking info. We have tool `sports_team_standing` but that's for teams and leagues; we need individual players. There's no direct tool. But maybe use general knowledge? However it's dynamic data (current rankings). As per policy, cannot fabricate or guess. Should respond with uncertainty.

We can say I don't know exactly who is top-ranked now because it changes frequently. Suggest checking ATP/WTA official sites. Provide explanation. No external browsing allowed. So answer accordingly.
